description: A read-only audit of one Base mainnet transaction. The response contains the receipt status, block number, confirmations, gas used, fee, value, sender and recipient, and every decoded ERC-20 Transfer event with token symbol and human-readable amount, as a Markdown certificate and structured JSON. All values are read live from public Base RPC at query time. [PAID: $1.05 USDC per call via x402]
name: base-tx-receipt-forensics-M11zEQ
